lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Uniform grid of high-intensity circular clusters organized in vertical columns; mid-flank columns exhibit 3 to 4 distinct nodes arranged in a repeating diagonal lattice.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots, creating a coordinate-like grid of high-luminance anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two continuous longitudinal ridges exhibiting high-contrast vertical gradients (luminescent crests with shadowed troughs) running parallel to the dorsal midline across the upper third of the flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Small, low-contrast high-luminance clusters scattered sparsely and irregularly across the medial surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dark, elevated protrusion at the anterior base of the dorsal fin, serving as a mounting point for an artificial external attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: Single high-luminance linear feature (tether or antenna) approximately 1.5 times the height of the dorsal fin, extending postero-dorsally from the dorsal fin base into the water column.
